description: Video handling presets — declarative, data-driven. App must probe via ffprobe (authoritative) and auto-convert via FFmpeg when incompatible; keep original untouched, stage temp, re-probe, validate before deploy, batch + cancel without corrupt final files. PROVISIONAL_UNVALIDATED until R36SX hardware tested.

presets.description: Conservative default TreeFrogUI video preset — DO NOT claim hardware compatibility from source assumptions alone; requires physical R36SX/SF3000 family validation

resolution.note: 640x480 for R36SX/GB350 4:3, 854x480 for SF3000 family 16:9 — panel-native is safest

stream_constraints.note: Firmware libffplayer hardware decoder; actual support varies by device

compatibility_hints.notes: Do NOT assume .mp4/.mkv compatible merely because extension appears in docs. Firmware uses libffplayer hardware decoder; actual supported codecs determined by firmware media plane, not libretro cores.

ffmpeg.command_template: ffmpeg -y -i <input> -c:v libx264 -profile:v baseline -level 3.0 -pix_fmt yuv420p -vf scale='min(640,iw)':-2:flags=lanczos -r 30 -c:a aac -ar 48000 -ac 2 -movflags +faststart <output>.mp4
ffmpeg.notes: This template is staged to temp and re-probed; only deployed after validation. User can override via declarative preset editing. Deterministic: <input_basename>.converted.mp4 in temp.

probe_adapter.when_incompatible: auto-convert via FFmpeg with staging + re-probe + validation
probe_adapter.when_unsupported: manual_review (e.g., no video stream, unknown container)
probe_adapter.when_inspection_error: inspection_error (ffprobe failed, file not found, invalid)

rules: If ffprobe fails or returns invalid JSON → inspection_error
If container not in compatibility.container (including aliases) → conversion_required (or unsupported if container completely unknown)
If video_codec not in compatibility.video_codec → conversion_required
If pixel_format not in compatibility.pixel_format → conversion_required
If width > max_width or height > max_height → conversion_required
If fps > max or fps < min → conversion_required
If audio_codec present and not in compatibility.audio_codec → conversion_required
If audio_sample_rate present and not in allowed and > max → conversion_required

warnings: PROVISIONAL_UNVALIDATED — do not claim hardware compatibility without physical R36SX/SF3000 family validation
Firmware hardware decoder support varies per device/firmware; this preset is conservative best-effort until device-tested
Never leave corrupt final files on cancel/interrupt — atomic rename only after validation
